title: 真实EROFS启动失败：用应用支持的PID路径恢复启动、访问、重启和清理
answer:
```python
import copy,os,pathlib,stat
def relocate_pid(config,runtime_directory):
    directory=pathlib.Path(runtime_directory)
    try:info=directory.lstat()
    except OSError as error:raise ValueError('existing private runtime directory required') from error
    if not directory.is_absolute() or not stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode) or info.st_uid!=os.geteuid() or info.st_mode&0o077 or not info.st_mode&stat.S_IWUSR:raise ValueError('owned private writable directory required')
    result=copy.deepcopy(config);result['pid_file']=str(directory/'app.pid');return result
```

原题知识说明：
核对实际写入路径与挂载，保留根文件系统只读目标并为必要临时目录提供受限可写挂载或调整应用路径。验证启动、运行、重启和清理流程；不能把数据卷权限问题与只读挂载错误混为一谈。

body:
## 操作任务
实现relocate_pid(config,runtime_directory)，使用应用现有pid_file参数，只将其改为绝对runtime_directory/app.pid并返回深拷贝。目录必须已存在、非软链接、当前UID拥有、owner可写且group/others无权限，否则ValueError；不创建/修改目录或权限，不改变read_only_root及其他参数，不改输入。原生检查在只读根文件系统和只读/tmp中实际启动本题HTTP教学应用，原/tmp/app.pid确报EROFS；私有/workspace运行目录可写，修复后健康和业务读取成功，两次启动使用不同PID且退出清理PID，持久数据与目录sentinel保持原值。不得重新挂载、提权或将根文件系统改可写。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
专用非root只读/tmp容器配置；本地验证复用既有镜像的--read-only，省去/tmp tmpfs并将工具临时目录放到/workspace。Kubernetes普通训练工作区可显式LAB_READ_ONLY_TMP=true仅把/tmp挂载设只读并给工具TMPDIR=/workspace；默认工作区不变，未部署或构建镜像。真实PID文件和HTTP教学进程，不代表生产应用/镜像兼容性或持久卷RPO。
rubric: 正确区分宿主与容器视角

import sys,os,pathlib,errno,subprocess,json,tempfile,copy,select,urllib.request
from contextlib import contextmanager
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
if not os.statvfs('/tmp').f_flag&os.ST_RDONLY:raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: dedicated read-only /tmp workspace required; validator --readonly-tmp or LAB_READ_ONLY_TMP=true; writable runner scratch via TMPDIR=/workspace')
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
app=pathlib.Path('checks/private_app.py').resolve()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-pid-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);runtime=root/'run';runtime.mkdir(mode=0o700);(runtime/'sentinel').write_bytes(b'keep runtime marker')
 data=root/'persistent';data.mkdir();record=data/'business.bin';record.write_bytes(b'approved persistent business\x00data');saved=record.read_bytes()
 config=dict(pid_file='/tmp/app.pid',data_file=str(record),read_only_root=True,owner='approved-app');before=copy.deepcopy(config)
 configfile=root/'app.json';configfile.write_text(json.dumps(config))
 failed=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(app),str(configfile)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
 assert failed.returncode==73 and json.loads(failed.stdout)==dict(started=False,errno=errno.EROFS,path='/tmp/app.pid'),failed.stdout+failed.stderr
 assert record.read_bytes()==saved
 print('NATIVE_READ_ONLY_TMP_PID_STARTUP_FAILED_WITH_EROFS',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:relocate_pid',flush=True)
 try:fixed=task.relocate_pid(config,str(runtime))
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student runtime path operation failed') from error
 assert config==before and {k:v for k,v in fixed.items() if k!='pid_file'}=={k:v for k,v in before.items() if k!='pid_file'},'unrelated config or root protection changed'
 @contextmanager
 def launch():
  configfile.write_text(json.dumps(fixed));p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(app),str(configfile)],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
  try:
   assert select.select([p.stdout],[],[],3)[0],'app startup response timed out'
   info=json.loads(p.stdout.readline());assert info.get('started') is True,info
   assert info['uid']==os.geteuid() and info['pid']==p.pid
   assert pathlib.Path(fixed['pid_file']).read_text()==str(p.pid)
   yield p,info
  finally:
   if p.poll() is None:p.stdin.write('stop\n');p.stdin.flush()
   try:p.wait(timeout=3)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:p.kill();p.wait(timeout=2)
   p.stdin.close();p.stdout.close();p.stderr.close()
 def read(port,path):
  opener=urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}))
  with opener.open('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(port)+path,timeout=1) as response:return response.read()
 pids=[]
 for _ in range(2):
  with launch() as (process,info):
   pids.append(process.pid);assert read(info['port'],'/health')==b'ready' and read(info['port'],'/data')==saved
   assert process.poll() is None and os.statvfs('/tmp').f_flag&os.ST_RDONLY
  assert process.returncode==0 and not pathlib.Path(fixed['pid_file']).exists(),'graceful exit left stale pid'
 assert pids[0]!=pids[1] and record.read_bytes()==saved
 assert fixed=={**before,'pid_file':str(runtime/'app.pid')}
 assert sorted(p.name for p in runtime.iterdir())==['sentinel']
 for bad in (str(record),'relative/runtime'):
  try:task.relocate_pid(config,bad)
  except ValueError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('non-directory/relative path accepted')
 link=root/'alias';link.symlink_to(runtime,target_is_directory=True)
 try:task.relocate_pid(config,str(link))
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('symlink runtime directory accepted')
 assert config==before and os.statvfs('/tmp').f_flag&os.ST_RDONLY
print('NATIVE_READ_ONLY_ROOT_APP_START_HTTP_RESTART_PID_CLEANUP_WITH_DATA_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
